This forces roots of unity satisfying 2^m-1 or 2^(m/2)+1 and orbit independence. Right multiplication breaks into inverse-pair 2x2 blocks with eigenvalues +/-1 if occupied and 0 if empty, and an independent trivial-character 0/1 block.
